_readme: S703 (worker levers for SkyDovekie), census lever 7 (San Joaquin Delta, page not found, 30). Capture 44883860902 read 24 programs as not_found and 6 as page_claimed. Free page read 45026053479 printed each near-miss page and each claimed program's first candidate (30 loads). Six apprenticeship programs (14594, 14595, 14597, 14598, 14599, 37611) are their own pages, refused by the coarse net's reading of hyphenated prefixes; the college's prefix_aliases now bind them (IND, ELE, MEC). The other 24 are filed here as named gaps, each with one of three reasons. The state's lists were not read in this session (the coci_program_courses read goes to the conductor). No model call, no Supabase write.

reasons.own_page_coverage_low: Own page found (title and award); the page prints few of the state's listed courses.
reasons.no_own_page: No page in the catalog is the program's own.
reasons.page_held_by_current_program: The page is the current program of the same name, which holds it; the state lists the older program beside it.
